content.text: {"label":"marketing_campaign","explanation":"General volume is running about 66-74% above forecast since 12:30, and service level has fallen to 3.8%. The excess is concentrated in loan_enquiry (3.5x normal, +110 calls in the last hour) and new_offer_enquiry (4.7x normal, +57 calls). This matches campaign MKT-2026-551, the 09:00 pre-approved personal loan email to 900k customers with a 'Call us to activate' call-to-action. Other causes look unlikely: there are no incidents, absences are at usual levels on both queues, AHT is near forecast and payments volume is normal.","plan_name":"Campaign surge recovery for general, 14:00-20:00","rationale":"General needs roughly 45 or more agents per interval against 29 on phones. That is a sustained gap of about 15 or more for the rest of the day, so capacity must be added, not only reshuffled. Overtime in consecutive offers covers 14:30-20:00. Expected cost is about Rs 9.5k on top of about Rs 2.9k already committed this morning, which stays under the Rs 15k budget. Cancelling coaching frees time on general at once and supports payments. Payments is also dipping (62.6% at 13:45), so this is applied to both queues. Delaying breaks on general for 14:00-15:00 borrows capacity before overtime agents arrive; agents already delayed this morning will be skipped. Callback for long waits on general smooths the peak and cuts abandons. Chat deflection takes 20% of new_offer_enquiry; loan_enquiry is not eligible. No cross-skill move from payments, because its service level is already below the 70% donor floor.
